column1: Hierophant: Sr/Fr Stolistes and Sr/Fr Dadouchos, will you please purify and consecrate the Hall with Water and with Fire.
The Stolistes returns to the East to complete the circle, traces a cross and circle in the air, then holds the Cup on high and says
Hegemon: Inheritor of a Dying World, arise and enter the Darkness.
column2: The Mother of Darkness hath blinded them with Her Hair.
